how the dietary changes needed to achieve the Eatwell Guide would affect health.
the health impact of dietary changes required to achieve the recommendations in the UK Government’s new dietary guidance (the ‘Eat Well Guide’).
the health implications of dietary change, and in particular the impact on the risk of developing type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease.

a shift towards the new Eatwell guide would be good for public health.

the health benefits of the new dietary guidelines are substantial.
the dietary changes required to achieve these benefits are substantial, and the benefits are likely to be greatest in those with the highest baseline risk.
the health benefits of dietary changes are large and should be a major driver for policy change.
